title: A Good Night's Sleep
paragraphs: Farid biasanya begadang sampai larut malam, menggulir ponselnya setelah hari kerja yang panjang. Di pagi hari, ia selalu merasa sangat lelah dan sulit fokus dengan baik saat rapat pertamanya. Suatu malam, ia akhirnya memutuskan untuk tidur lebih awal, tepat setelah menyelesaikan shalat Isya. Ia menyimpan ponselnya di ruangan lain dan menarik napas dalam-dalam perlahan untuk menenangkan pikirannya sebelum memejamkan mata.

Keesokan paginya, Farid bangun untuk shalat Subuh dengan perasaan benar-benar segar dan pikiran yang jernih, sesuatu yang hampir ia lupa masih mungkin terjadi di hari kerja. Rapat pertamanya berjalan lancar, dan ide-idenya terasa lebih tajam dari biasanya. Setelah satu minggu penuh dengan rutinitas baru ini, Farid mengatakan kepada istrinya bahwa tidur yang cukup diam-diam mengubah kualitas seluruh hari kerjanya, jauh lebih baik daripada secangkir kopi mana pun.
answerKey: Farid usually stays awake very late at night, scrolling through his phone after a long day of work. In the morning, he always feels extremely tired and finds it hard to focus properly during his first meeting. One night, he finally decides to sleep earlier, right after finishing Isha prayer. He puts his phone in another room and takes a few slow, deep breaths to calm his mind before closing his eyes. The next morning, Farid wakes up for Fajr prayer feeling truly fresh and clear-headed, something he had almost forgotten was possible on a weekday. His first meeting goes smoothly, and his ideas feel sharper than usual. After a full week of this new routine, Farid tells his wife that a good night's sleep has quietly changed the quality of his entire workday, far more than any cup of coffee ever could.
